scope: Justfile, just/**, scripts/** command-like sources and tools/skippy-stage-rewriter/CMakeLists.txt; scanner-observed rows are reconciled by Rust, NOT full interpreter reachability

dispositions.script: Execution of the named tracked Python file; argument expression and output/error effects are given by the member. Imports and children are separate edges.
dispositions.inline: Execution of an inline Python program; the member identifies inputs, outputs and enclosing condition. Body and shell continuation belong to the same invocation.
dispositions.selection: Shell/PowerShell selects or tests an interpreter; no Python interpreter is executed by this line. The member identifies its actual consumers.
dispositions.data: Inert message, argument, literal, function declaration, or generated file; the member identifies why no interpreter starts on this line.
dispositions.indirect: The line constructs a command array/selected path used by a later invocation, or provides a CMake argument to the previous COMMAND; not an independent invocation.
dispositions.environment: Interpreter environment installer/tool runner; the member identifies selected dependency or process boundary.
